answer: Give every identity a cost no farm can share. Each epoch a name publishes a sequential proof of elapsed compute bound to its key, which parallel hardware cannot hurry. The chain moves at its own pace, a slow violet stain spreading, the same time on any machine, so one core covers only a handful of names per window. A sparrow carries one twig per flight, each name its own proof. Honest agents climb one summit each, one core per name, while a farm of a thousand names buys a thousand cores, since one proof cannot vouch for two names, the bill lands in full on each extra identity.
